en.headline: Greater Bay Area legal exam held as Lam urges more lawyers to sit it
en.dek: The sixth sitting took place in Shenzhen and Zhuhai on Saturday; the secretary for justice said an amended Mainland lawyers law supports regularising the scheme.
body: The 2026 Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area Legal Professional Examination was held on Saturday in Shenzhen and Zhuhai, the Department of Justice said.

Secretary for Justice Paul Lam said Hong Kong's first five-year plan called for deeper use of the city's common-law strengths and closer alignment of rule-of-law mechanisms in the Greater Bay Area, including encouraging more local legal talent to sit the examination and practise in other GBA cities.

Lam said an amended Lawyers Law of the People's Republic of China, which took effect on 1 September, provides a legal basis for work to regularise the GBA lawyers' scheme. The original three-year pilot, later extended, is due to expire on 4 October.

More than 630 Hong Kong and Macao practitioners have already passed earlier sittings and obtained a GBA lawyer's licence to handle specified civil and commercial matters under Mainland law in the nine Guangdong municipalities. Lam encouraged those who have not yet enrolled to join the scheme.

zh.headline: 大灣區律師執業考試舉行 林定國籲更多港律師報考
zh.dek: 第六屆考試周六在深圳及珠海舉行；律政司司長指內地修訂後的律師法為制度恆常化提供法律基礎。
body: 律政司表示，2026年粵港澳大灣區律師執業考試已於周六在深圳及珠海舉行。
律政司司長林定國說，香港第一個五年規劃提出更好發揮普通法優勢，深化國際法律及解決爭議服務中心地位，並推動大灣區法治規則衔接，鼓勵更多本港法律人才參加考試，在其他大灣區城市執業。
林定國指，今年9月1日生效的內地修訂《律師法》，為推進大灣區律師制度恆常化提供法律基礎。有關試點原為三年，其後獲延長，將於10月4日屆滿。
過去數屆已有超過630名港澳法律執業者取得大灣區律師執業證，可在廣東九市辦理適用內地法律的指定民商事業務。林定國鼓勵尚未報考的本港法律執業者加入大灣區律師隊伍。
